info.name: RanaMatch Agent & Affiliate Backend API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Agent Portal, Affiliate Portal, Admin Console Management, and System endpoints.

### Environment Variables
- `base_url`: `http://localhost/` or `http://localhost:8080/`
- `agent_jwt_token`: Bearer JWT token from `/agent/auth/login`
- `affiliate_jwt_token`: Bearer JWT token from `/affiliate/auth/login`
- `admin_jwt_token`: Admin session / JWT token
